org: U.S. Department of Agriculture: Food and Nutrition Administration
description: WIC is a federal Supplemental Nutrition Program that runs locally through state clinics with the aim to help provide healthy foods, personalized nutrition education, and breastfeeding support.
whatThisIs: WIC provides eligible participants with benefits to purchase approved nutritious foods, as well as personalized nutrition education, breastfeeding support, health screenings, and referrals to other services
whoItHelps: Individuals who are currently pregnant or Postpartum (up to 6 months after the end of a pregnancy, Those who are breastfeeding, up to the infant's first birthday.,  Parents and caregivers of infants and children under age five, including fathers, grandparents, guardians, and other eligible caregivers applying on a child's behalf.
whatToKnow: If you have previously been rejected from federal programs due to income, keep in mind with the new child your household has changed an you may now qualify.
Nutrition education: Offers guidance on healthy eating, pregnancy nutrition, infant feeding, and children's nutritional needs
Breastfeeding support: Provides education, counseling, and assistance with breastfeeding.
name: WIC (Women Children & Infant)
